title: Dreaming (EAVT rows → EAVT rows; the settling arrow over memory)
description: Dreaming consolidates a trace of EAVT rows into derived EAVT rows — the aperiodic→finite settling arrow over MEMORY, as pure structure work (pass / witness / generate via extension or restriction). ONE morphism read on the bigraded KZ-diamond's two axes; the four named corners (aperiodic/transfinite/scott-continuous/finite) are diagonal cells, NOT a ladder. Input and output are arrays of eavt-row — exactly {e,a,v,t} of OUR structures, no extra fields. `regime` selects the corner (a claim-tagged choice carried in opts at call time, not a schema enum). Variance: coincidence (declared). Per docs/GENEALOGY.md §5.
